gaps.explanation: The report itself does not add up; no printed line exists to add. Trimmed p10 Exhibit H (Departmental Analysis of General Fund Receipts and Disbursements) prints 17 disbursement lines, all already in detail[] (indexes 12-28): 2,280.00 + 100,977.41 + 7,460.05 + 2,940.49 + 209.37 + 1,707.00 + 27,848.00 + 1,313.23 + 1,922.00 + 603.66 + 16,389.84 + 429.10 + 147.54 + 543.06 + 2,533.60 + 717.59 + 6,788.95 = 174,810.89, but its printed Total Disbursements is 189,138.55 (difference 14,327.66). The printed total agrees with Exhibit D (p5) General Fund total disbursements 189,138.55 (General government 188,929.18 + Park 209.37) and Exhibit G (p9) General government operating disbursements actual 188,929.18. Neither Exhibit G (p9) nor any other trimmed page (pp1-13) itemizes the missing 14,327.66, so it cannot be assigned to a printed line. Special Revenue (p11: 19,985.50 + 3,772.00 + 42,028.62 = 65,786.12) and Debt Service (p12: 25,000 + 6,305 + 54 = 31,359.00) schedules are complete. Schedule 271,956.01 + 14,327.66 (unprinted) = 286,283.67 statement total. Already recorded in the report's report_discrepancies.
